title: Ep 14 — Cursor's GitHub rival launches into a global GitHub outage, and the podcast tool that hit sixteen thousand a month
description: Cursor's new GitHub alternative, Origin, opens to beta users on the very day GitHub and Copilot go down worldwide, OpenAI expands ChatGPT Ads across thirty-one European markets and pauses frontier-model training over cyber-capability concerns, and Claude Code ships two quick releases including auto-resume on usage limits. Plus a deep dive on podcast-repurposing tool Podsqueeze, founder Tiago Ferreira's climb to sixteen thousand dollars a month, and a touched-but-unchanged week for the Fundraising Regulator's still-pending prize-draw ruling.
